name: Sour clam soup
summary: Canh ngao nấu chua is a sour soup of local clam or ngao tây, one of the three soups in the seafood meal.
origin: Hạ Long. The Cái Dăm table served ngao tây nấu chua.
howToEat: A sour soup of local clam or ngao tây.
where: The soup course of the ordinary meal. Not a named stall.
seoTitle: Canh ngao chua — sour clam soup in Ha Long
seoDescription: Canh ngao nấu chua is a sour soup of local clam or ngao tây in the Hạ Long seafood meal.
